newsitem.title: USA: Miami Computer to acquire Force 4.
newsitem.headline: Miami Computer to acquire Force 4.

text.p: Miami Computer Supply Corp said Tuesday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Force 4 D.P. Supplies Inc, which would operate as a wholly owned Miami Computer subsidiary.
Terms of the deal were undisclosed.
Miami Computer said in a news release that the acquisition should add six percent to eight percent to its earnings on an annualized basis by the fourth quarter of 1997.
Force 4, based in Portland, Ore., is a computer supply and office automation products distributor with annual sales of $14 million.
Force 4 President Daniel Wisdom is to remain in that position under the new arrangement, Miami Computer said.
Miami Computer distributes computer and office automation supplies. Its shares were down 1/2 to 11-3/4 in mid-afternoon Nasdaq trading.
